quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Calamity pass (China travel retail destocking and debt leverage). Pre-calamity FY2021 peak Owner EPS ($6.599) subjected to a 24.2% conservative haircut to $5.00 to strip out unsustainable daigou channel-stuffing and post-COVID travel retail bubble volumes, calibrating to a sustainable post-turnaround mid-teens EBIT margin on $15.5B sales. Operating ROIC normalized to 35.0% cap reflecting high gross margins (74%) and capital-light prestige beauty intangibles. 5-10Y through-the-cycle growth calibrated to 6.0% (3.0% volume + 2.0% price + 1.0% luxury mix - 0.5% restructuring/marketing drag + 0.5% buybacks). Balance sheet carries elevated net debt ($3.31B, 2.34x interest coverage) requiring ongoing PRGP cost reduction and dividend moderation to deleverage.
